title: Name your first product
detail: Nothing exists until it has a name on it.

title: Ship it
detail: Finished beats perfect. Get version one out the door.

title: Score 40 or better
detail: The press won't love your first one. Make them not hate it.

title: Hire somebody
detail: You can't be the whole company forever.

title: Sign a client contract
detail: Client work pays the rent while the product finds its feet.

title: End a week in the black
detail: One Sunday night with more money than you started with.

title: Move into the loft
detail: Three people is the garage's ceiling.

title: Build a team of three
detail: You, and three people who chose to be here.

title: Score 60 or better
detail: The second one should be visibly better than the first.

title: Research two technologies
detail: Somebody has to think about next year.

title: Take a real weekend
detail: Rest doesn't count. Go and do something.

title: Go on a date
detail: There is a life outside the loft. Allegedly.

title: Take the studio lease
detail: Fourteen desks, a whiteboard, and a rent bill to match.

title: Form a department
detail: Hire a lawyer, an HR lead or an ops manager and let them run it.

title: Score 75 or better
detail: Good enough that people recommend it unprompted.

title: Weather three market crashes
detail: Still trading when the third one clears.

title: Earn $75,000 from one product
detail: Lifetime revenue, not a good week.

title: Move in together
detail: Somebody else's coffee cups in your sink.

title: Keep six people a year
detail: Six people who have each been with you twelve months. Hiring is easy; this isn't.

title: Four profitable quarters in a row
detail: More in the account at the end of each quarter than the start. Four times, no gaps.

title: Own a topic
detail: Beat every rival's share in a market you ship into.

title: Buy your office
detail: Stop paying rent. The deeds, with your name on them.

title: Raise a round
detail: Somebody else's money, and somebody else's opinions.

title: Put twenty people on payroll
detail: The point where you stop knowing what everyone did today.

title: Own a topic
detail: Beat every rival's share in a market you ship into.

title: Buy a rival outright
detail: Their team, their market, their name off the door.

title: Open the campus
detail: Forty desks and a lobby with your name in it.

title: Build three amenities
detail: The perks that make people stay when a rival calls.

title: Keep two products live for 26 weeks
detail: Half a year with two things on sale at once. A company, not a product.

title: Eight profitable quarters in a row
detail: Two straight years in the black. The number Still yours asks for.

title: Score 85 or better
detail: The one the investors start calling about. Let them.

title: Bank $250,000
detail: Cash on hand, and none of it anybody else's.

title: Form a department
detail: Hire a lawyer, an HR lead or an ops manager and let them run it.

title: Get married
detail: Somebody who was there for all of it.

title: Be ready to go public
detail: A $5M valuation, three profitable quarters, and something that bills monthly.

title: Score 90 or better
detail: The one they'll still be writing about in five years.

title: Be worth a million
detail: Your wallet plus your slice of what you built.

title: Reach the frontier
detail: Research something at the top of the tech tree.

title: Raise three children
detail: The other thing you built.

title: Be worth five million
detail: The number that makes acquirers pick up the phone.

title: Be ready to call it built
detail: Eight profitable quarters in a row, a name people know, and every share still yours.

title: Five years in
detail: Most companies never get here. Yours did, on its own money.
